summary: CapsoVision filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement under its existing S-3 shelf for an at-the-market offering of up to $100 million of common stock through Cantor Fitzgerald as sales agent. The filing is a routine capital-raising mechanism, not a special situation. Share price was $6.86 on August 12, 2026. Cantor receives up to 3.0% in commissions. No minimum sales are required, and no escrow is involved. This is an ordinary shelf takedown with no strategic event, catalyst, or deal structure. What to watch: actual sales cadence and dilution impact on existing shareholders.
